q1.question: Why is my vessel showing as offline?
q1.answer: Vessels may show offline due to poor satellite coverage, device battery issues, or antenna obstructions. Check the device power indicator and ensure clear sky visibility.

q2.question: How often does the GPS location update?
q2.answer: GPS updates every 30 seconds when moving, and every 5 minutes when anchored to conserve battery life.

q3.question: How do I add a new boat to my fleet?
q3.answer: Navigate to Dashboard > Fleet Management > Add Vessel. Enter vessel details and tracking device ID to activate.

q4.question: Can I track my fleet from mobile?
q4.answer: Yes! Download our mobile app on iOS and Android to monitor vessels in real-time with instant alerts.
